title: Scheduled outages in the contact plan: storage at rover, relay and Earth
summary: Two planned outages that every node knows from the contact plan, each also enforced by the emulator: the rover-Gateway leg is down from 25 s to 50 s (rover out of view of the Gateway), and the Gateway-Earth leg is down from 65 s to 85 s (no Earth contact). The rover sends one telemetry envelope per second and answers PINGs; Mission Control sends a signed PING every 6 s. Envelopes are expected to wait in ION storage at the node in front of the closed leg and to be delivered after the contact resumes.

outages.label: rover out of view of the Gateway (planned)

criteria.text: Every rover envelope handed to ION is received at Earth
Every Earth command handed to ION is received at the rover
Every received envelope is byte-identical to the envelope handed to ION
Every received envelope is accepted (no TTL expired in storage)
At 45 s the rover node holds rover envelopes sent since the rover-Gateway outage began
At 45.5 s the Gateway node holds Earth commands waiting for the rover contact
At 80 s the Gateway node holds rover envelopes sent since 63 s, waiting for the Earth contact
At 80.5 s the Earth node holds commands waiting for the Gateway contact
Rover envelopes sent during the rover-Gateway outage arrive no earlier than its end (50 s) plus 1.55 s propagation
Earth commands sent during the rover-Gateway outage arrive no earlier than its end plus 0.25 s
Rover envelopes sent during the Gateway-Earth outage arrive no earlier than its end (85 s) plus 1.3 s
Earth commands sent during the Gateway-Earth outage arrive no earlier than its end plus 1.55 s
No duplicate or unknown envelope is received
No receiver accepts an envelope older than its TTL
No node transmits into a scheduled outage (emulator blackout drops = 0)
LTP segments from the Gateway discarded by Earth's LTP screening (informative)
LTP segments from the rover discarded by the Gateway's LTP screening (informative)
Checkpoints the Gateway resent to Earth (informative)

conformance.how: store-and-forward delivery across complete scheduled outages (S2-1, S2-2, S2-5 to S2-12)
S2-3: headers unchanged after storage in ION
envelopes stored as bundles at the rover, the relay and Earth (S2-5 to S2-8)
